Personality: Ranaon is an outlier among the Battanian nobility, casting aside the recklessness common to the children of the forest in favor of cool rationality. As a far-sighted administrator, she possesses a high sense of honor and a generous nature, yet proves cold and pragmatic when handling state affairs, harbouring no superfluous pity. Uninterested in charging across battlefields, she prefers to draw upon her expertise in engineering and medicine to command the broader situation through precise calculation and efficient logistics. In social settings, she conducts herself with graceful poise and considerable charm, always maintaining the dignity of a highborn lady. Intimately familiar with the mechanics of power, in complex political maneuvering she is always the operator behind the scenes who weighs pros and cons to maximize her clan's interests—a composure that inspires a measure of dread even in her enemies.
Background: Ranaon hails from the illustrious Battanian house of fen Derngil as the daughter of the clan leader Ergeon and niece of the late King Aeril. Growing up within the halls of Dunglanys, she witnessed her family's patient forbearance amid shifts in royal power. Although her clan privately despises High King Caladog as an upstart and suspects his involvement in the disappearance of the previous king, under her father's guidance Ranaon has faithfully maintained allegiance to the crown so as to prevent Battania from descending into anarchic chaos. As a future pillar of her house, she not only excels in horsemanship and leadership, but also displays astonishing gifts in siege weaponry and medical care. Representing Clan fen Derngil's devotion to order, she is at once a generous lady and a stern guardian in sustaining the prosperity of Aster Castle and Dunglanys.
